summary: San Francisco resident, former Seattle resident, computer science degree holder, software engineer with experience at Microsoft, strong opinions on programming practices, particularly in C and C++, critical of corporate culture and work-life balance, politically liberal, supportive of Biden, interested in open-source software and Linux, has lived in both DC and California, enjoys discussing technical details and programming paradigms, has a history of working with low-level programming and operating systems, critical of the tech industry's treatment of young employees, has a nuanced view of government and bureaucracy, expresses concern about age discrimination in tech.
